g.text: Terms: AI artificial intelligence · CR-nn confirmation review of a work product, CR-nn (WP-M-06 §4) · FSR-nn functional safety requirement (FSC) · HARA hazard analysis and risk assessment (ISO 26262-3) · HMI human-machine interface: display, sounds, cluster · ODD operational design

domain: where the system is meant to work · PAS publicly available specification (ISO/PAS 8800 is the AI safety one) · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448): hazards with nothing failing · SR-nn independent SOTIF or AI evaluation review, SR-nn (WP-M-06 §7) · TARA threat

analysis and risk assessment (ISO/SAE 21434) · UN-nn software unit (WP-W-05 §2) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
